inputDefinition: The parity inputs of harmony2.json: the seed-stability recipes' PCA coordinates, subset to at most 6000 cells per dataset with seed 4444

criteria.fullFits: CyteArc's full fits agree with the reference's as closely as the reference's own fits agree across seeds: the median 15-NN overlap of CyteArc and reference fits over all seed pairs is at least the smallest overlap between two reference seeds, and the medians of the two tools' iLISI differ by at most the range of the reference's iLISI across seeds.
